members: Ashley Hurst, Rachel, John Keever, Marika, Gilly
happened: Group 1 built an automated workflow that wakes when an email request lands, reads the email, uses email and the CRM, names a specialist, and hands off to that named specialist. The instruction is to create the case in the CRM, assign it to a case specialist, and connect the case to the appropriate opportunity and contact.
issue: The next person still has to guess who owns it next and who it is for. A case specialist is a role, not a named owner, and the board never says which policy or person this is for, or that the email is from a wealth strategist.
why: The outcome is a simple document: job in plain words, the tools needed, and a real person who owns it next. The CRM intake job and the tools are clear. The next owner is not a named person, and who it is for is still inside the email. Someone who was not in the group would still have to guess which specialist and which policy.

board.container: Automated Workflow — if this, then that
board.instruction: Create the case in the CRM and assign it to a case specialist. Connect the case to the appropriate opportunity and contact in the CRM.
